slides.title: Check that enrolment is open
slides.html: The line at the top says until when Deploy App accepts phones. Red means closed: press Open Deploy App ↗ and there Open for 2 hours.

slides.title: Hand over the new settings
slides.html: After every opening, press Open in the MDM connector again. Your MDM needs the new challenge before the phones ask.

slides.title: Use them
slides.html: The new tab asks first. Press Use the new settings, and your MDM gets the new challenge.

slides.title: See who is waiting
slides.html: Check that the phones waiting for a name are in your hands, and that each shows its apps in its Work tab.

slides.title: Give callsigns
slides.html: With no phone selected, press Give callsigns and type a prefix under Numbered. Every phone without a name gets a number in the order they joined, and the preview shows who gets what.

slides.title: Or use your own list
slides.html: Choose From a list and type one callsign per line. Keep the rest of the list for next time keeps the callsigns left over.

slides.title: Callsign rules
slides.html: Use 3–32 letters, digits or hyphens, with no hyphen at either end; the button waits until every row passes. A callsign is never given twice: raise First number if higher numbers were used before.

slides.title: Name them
slides.html: Press Name 6 phones. Your MDM asks each phone for its certificate; with Fleet, a phone answers within about 15 minutes.

slides.title: Wait until all are ready
slides.html: The count above the table says how many are ready. The table updates by itself every minute.

slides.title: Close enrolment
slides.html: Each phone also appears on Deploy App's MDM page under its callsign. When all are in, press Close.
